usage: The word 細路 (sai3 lou6) is a noun used to refer to young children or kids, typically in informal contexts.
It can be used to talk about one's own children or other children in general.
細路 often appears in sentences as the subject or object, just like other countable nouns.
You can use 細路 when describing what kids do, how they behave, or when parents are talking about them.
It is a casual term commonly used in everyday conversation in Hong Kong.
